For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Md. Rashid Alam, Advocate  For the Respondent/s : Mr. Narsingh Tanti, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DR. ANSHUMAN  ORAL ORDER 4 23-03-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State present.

The present criminal revision petition has been filed for setting aside the judgment and order dated 18.02.2017 passed in Cr. Appeal No. 78 of 2016 by the Additional District & Sessions Judge-III,
Gopalganj by which the judgment and order dated 13.04.2016 passed in Complaint Case No. 1027 of 2009 (Trial No. 1760 of 2016) in which conviction has been made under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code is under challenged.
It transpires from the record that one Sajiya Parveen was the complainant who filed criminal case under section 498A Patna High Court CR. REV. No.604 of 2017(4) dt.23-03-2023 against Md.
Mohasin in which conviction has been made to Md. Mohsin.

Md. Mohsin being aggrieved and dissatisfied from the order of conviction under section 498A pursue by Sajiya Parveen has preferred Cr. Appeal No. 78 of 2016 in which the Addl. District and Sessions Judge-III, Gopalganj has acquitted the appellant and set aside the order passed by the Judicial Magistrate-Ist Class in Complaint Case No. 1027 of 2009.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge-III, Gopalganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the present criminal revision the said Sajiya Parveen who was the complainant has not preferred the revision rather his father has preferred the said revision.

sentences.text: Let counsel for the petitioner is directed to file a supplementary affidavit about the maintainability of present criminal revision as the present revisionist is not party either in the complaint case or in the criminal appeal.
He is directed to file the said affidavit within six weeks.
Put up this case after six weeks i.e. on 04.05.2023.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) ravishankar/-
